mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.2% compresses risk-free rates and increases equity valuation multiples, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates decline.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS <= 0.2% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending capacity.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns following UNRATE > 0.3pp rise are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.02 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeding 0.5% from prior month indicate contracting consumer demand, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate earnings expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decline > 0.5% and GDPC1 decline > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline > 0.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or joint Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing output contraction below 90.0 (index 2017=100) in INDPRO signals reduced industrial activity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through lower corporate production and profit margins.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during INDPRO < 90.0 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained year-over-year decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates weakening residential demand, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced consumer spending and construction sector earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during HOUST YoY decline are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI index increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points from the prior month signals accelerating inflation, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated central bank rate hikes.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns following CPIAUCSL > 0.5pp rise are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 0.5% and unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases exceeding 0.3 percentage points from prior month indicate labor market deterioration, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced consumer income and spending.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decline > 0.5% and UNRATE rise > 0.3pp from prior month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns when PAYEMS decline > 0.5% and UNRATE rise > 0.3pp are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or joint Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation-low interest rate regime (CPIAUCSL > 210 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%) triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to policy normalization risks and reduced real yields.
regime_hint: high inflation, low interest rate regime
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during CPIAUCSL > 210 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.2% periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or joint Rank IC falls below 0.02.
